claims.text: Sills (hamstring) was activated from injured reserve by the Buccaneers on Thursday, Scott Smith of the team's official website reports.

claims.author: Terry McCormick
claims.text: Titans head coach Robert Saleh said Monday that Townsend is still being evaluated after sustaining a left knee injury in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Browns, Terry McCormick of TitanInsider.com reports.

claims.author: Jim Wyatt
claims.text: The Titans signed Horne from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, Jim Wyatt of the team's official site reports.

claims.author: Jim Wyatt
claims.text: The Titans opened Mausi's 21-day practice window Wednesday, Jim Wyatt of the team's official website reports.

claims.author: Nicki Jhabvala
claims.text: Coach Dan Quinn noted Monday that with Terry McLaurin (knee) out for the season, Stefon Diggs' workload isn't expected to change much, however others, notably Williams, should see added opportunities in McLaurin's looming absence, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

claims.author: Nicki Jhabvala
claims.text: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn said Monday that Mariota (knee) is on track to return to practice this week, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

claims.author: Tashan Reed
claims.text: Lane underwent surgery Oct. 9 to repair his fractured and dislocated ankle, and he is expected to be cleared for activities before OTAs, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.

claims.author: John Keim
claims.text: Kinlaw (knee) won't return to Washington's matchup versus the 49ers on Monday, John Keim of ESPN reports.
